title: Travel: John Lennon – New York City to St Thomas | 1971
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono flew from New York City to St Thomas in the Virgin Islands on 14 September 1971.

The visit was ahead of a custody hearing for Ono’s eight-year-old daughter Kyoko, which began place two days later.

During the flight Lennon wrote right-to-reply letters to journalists Craig McGregor and John Hoyland, and another to Mike Evans of the Music Liberation Front, which had invited Lennon and Ono to perform in Liverpool on 11 October. Lennon declined the offer.

Sounds interesting, we’ll be in U.S.A in Oct, we got court cases, films to edit, and Museums to fill, if we think of anything we’ll call or write. anyway, THIS is a letter of support. “F” the fascists!
John Lennon
